brief: Plan one useful community post for a fictional repair and trade-in service.
result: Create a short “Before you hand over your device” checklist: back up what you need, remove personal information and ask how the service handles batteries. Invite readers to ask about the process.
rationale: EPA guidance gives the checklist a practical basis. A Business Profile update is one possible publishing format; the example does not schedule or publish it.
considerations: Adapt device-specific instructions to the manufacturer’s guidance. Do not promise complete data erasure from this checklist alone.

sources.title: EPA: Electronics Donation and Recycling
sources.statement: EPA guidance recommends deleting personal information before donating or recycling electronics and handling batteries separately when appropriate.

sources.title: Google Business Profile: Create and manage posts
sources.statement: Business Profile posts can communicate updates, offers and events to customers on Google.
